items.name: Mohamed Mostafa Abouzeid
items.bio: Mohamed co-founded Maram Group with a vision to transform the real estate landscape in Egypt. His expertise in business development and strategic planning has been instrumental in establishing the company's reputation for excellence and innovation.

items.name: Ahmed Mostafa Abouzeid
items.bio: Ahmed founded Maram Group with a commitment to delivering exceptional real estate projects. As CEO, he oversees the company's strategic direction, ensuring every project meets the highest standards of quality and design excellence.

items.name: Eslam Hashem Saleh
items.bio: Eslam leads the contract management function, overseeing all project agreements and ensuring compliance with terms and timelines. His attention to detail and strong negotiation skills ensure smooth project execution from start to finish.
